header.settings: defaults kept (see plan_settings in the input)

findings: PR-OA-open (run of exchange) failed supply: invalid traffic 4.4%, viewable rate 45.0%, 0.34 GA4 sessions per click, 6.56 impressions per user a week against a cap of 5, and 38% of its spend on made-for-advertising domains. It is replaced by open auction on an allow list.
Its 31 view-through conversions are the most of any line; they are reported, never used in a verdict.
Retargeting and contextual PMP kept: confirmed CPA $240.00 and $260.00 against the $283.24 ceiling.
Video retune: viewable CPM $17.54 over the $15.00 ceiling and completion 66.0% under 70%. The plan caps video at a $8.77 media CPM.
The pool can absorb $6,704.94 at the cap, less than the $8,100.00 a 25% share would give it, so $1,395.06 moves to prospecting.

standards.viewability: MRC: display 50% of pixels on screen for 1 continuous second (30% for ads of 242,500 pixels or more), video 50% for 2 continuous seconds; target 70% of measured impressions

standards.frequency: 5 per user per week on prospecting, 10 on retargeting, set at line level across devices

supply_rules: buy only from sellers listed as authorized in each site's ads.txt or each app's app-ads.txt, and prefer DIRECT sellers

confirmed conversions = the lower of DSP click-through conversions and GA4 purchases from the line's tagged sessions
